title: Fixed Pedal and Raised Lid Waste Bin
description: One original complete static foot-pedal waste-bin appearance in a fixed open-lid pose. A single continuous thick tapered cylindrical shell has a real deep open interior and complete inner floor, supported above ground on four finite short feet. One whole circular cap is raised about a rear horizontal hinge with full support ears; a front tread pad joins one complete below-bin lever and pivot, and one continuous rear rod reaches a fixed lid ear. All geometry newly authored rather than an extracted liner from the three-stream collection station or an attached-lid tote repainted. Three opaque constant PBR materials. One prop, zero scenes or additional poses; empty and unmarked. No actual pedal motion, hinge travel, rod mechanism validation, closure seal, waste category, sanitation, capacity, load, manufacture or safety certification.
